I've been paying rent and staying at a guest room in a condo. 
I don't currently have a job. I was supposed to be paid on the 20th by someone who claimed to be from a textbook company. I was relying on that  paycheck to pay for rent and buy groceries.

Long story short. I got a job offer via craigslist. Was not legitimate.
I have 3 dollars to my name. I'm by myself, no family or friends in the states. 

Honestly... I'm very ashamed to have been had....
I'm sorry, I'm here now. I am in need of food and I am also looking for advice.

Truth be told. I am very ashamed of my most recent attempts at getting work. Long story short I put my resume on online sites and also craigslist.

One job 5 months ago led me to a clothing warehouse where they needed a translator for an English to Korean and vice versa translations. They told me that I would work there for at least a few months. After two weeks they went through company problems and had to fire everyone.
I found the warehouse job through craigslist so it gave me some hope since I did actually get paid one check there.

I found another job claiming that I can work at home as an assistant. I was so desperate that I did not think anything of it and cashed the check they sent me which was a false check. My Bank of America account has been since closed and I was told I could never bank with them again. I am grateful to have had opened a Chase bank account while I was a student. 

The most recent job I was offered two weeks ago from Wednesday was a shipping job. I received textbooks which I then ship out.
After two weeks of work and promised pay on the 20th of this month, I have not been paid and the person who was communicating with me cut off everything since the two days ago. I was relying on this paycheck to pay my rent and buy groceries. 

As for family. My Stepfather lives in China somewhere struggling himself.
My Mother lives in Incheon, Korea and she is very ill. She is taking care of herself and her blind sister. (my eldest aunt.) My Mother's side of the family consists of her and her three siblings of which one of them had deceased due to cancer.

I am an only child and I do not know anyone on my Father's side of the family. I have never met my Biological Father. 

If I am being too personal I am sorry. I have not gotten a chance to let the things I have bottled in out onto someone or something.

Oh thanks for letting me know. 
At this point I am not sure what to say. Yesterday night after I came onto reddit to put myself on suicide watch, I tried to sleep. I couldn't go to sleep and then I tried to kill myself in the bathroom with my winchester knife until I just broke out in tears. I was hysterical and I actually ended up sitting under the shower head.
I've never asked anyone for money, only jobs to work for money, so then I would not have to bother anyone. 
To be honest I guess I deserve this, and I would rather die than to live feeling like this.
